scope: Resolve the remaining dynamic Startup.xml window-target contract; source and read-only native label check, no startup navigation or setting mutation.
finding: Supported in Piers and current published master: the label serializes the integer lookandfeel.startupwindow setting; ReplaceWindow dispatches via ActivateWindow<true>; the window translator accepts full numeric IDs.
